title: Use override_dh_auto_install for the conffile instead
description:
Tested by booting a resolute `lxc` VM, installing all the 4 Google guest packages from `-proposed` (including `google-compute-engine-oslogin` which is what was crashing in excuses) and verified that it does indeed crash when trying to instal `google-guest-agent` from `-proposed`.

Made the changes in this MP, uploaded it to a PPA (https://launchpad.net/~kajiya/+archive/ubuntu/gga-v2/+packages), downloaded the .deb file to the VM (I'm impatient and didn't wait for it to publish) and installed it via `sudo apt install ./google-guest-agent_20260115.00-0ubuntu3~ppa1_amd64v3.deb`

Verified that it installed/didn't crash out from dpkg!

(Pastebin of the `dpkg -s` outputs here: https://pastebin.ubuntu.com/p/H65kMKHNJY/)
commit_message:
Use override_dh_auto_install for the conffile instead

Fix/clean up the postinst
diff:
diff --git a/debian/changelog b/debian/changelog
index 3f17ee9..240c4f6 100644
--- a/debian/changelog
+++ b/debian/changelog
@@ -1,3 +1,19 @@
+google-guest-agent (20260115.00-0ubuntu3) resolute; urgency=medium
+
+  * Use override_dh_auto_install for the conffile and clean up
+    the postinst
+    * Install `/etc/google-guest-agent/core-plugin-enabled` as
+      a conffile (set to default "true") instead of creating it
+      from scratch in the postinst (and possibly introducing more
+      weird behaviour)
+    * Drop the custom enable/starting logic from the
+      google-guest-agent.postinst file and just keep
+      the (best effort) disable/stop of the old unit files
+      (google-guest-agent.service and
+      gce-workload-cert-refresh.timer)
+
+ -- Chloé 'kajiya' Smith <chloe.smith@canonical.com>  Thu, 26 Feb 2026 22:35:23 +0000
+
 google-guest-agent (20260115.00-0ubuntu2) resolute; urgency=medium
 
   * Now with the actual *.orig-google-guest-agent.tar.xz blob
diff --git a/debian/google-guest-agent.postinst b/debian/google-guest-agent.postinst
index 4070f58..2105db1 100644
--- a/debian/google-guest-agent.postinst
+++ b/debian/google-guest-agent.postinst
@@ -1,36 +1,23 @@
 #!/bin/sh
 set -e
 
-STATE_DIR="/etc/google-guest-agent"
-STATE_FILE="${STATE_DIR}/core-plugin-enabled"
-
 case "$1" in
   configure)
-    mkdir --parents "$STATE_DIR"
-
-    # Just default to true if unset
-    if [ ! -e "$STATE_FILE" ]; then
-      printf '%s' 'true' > "$STATE_FILE"
-      chmod 0644 "$STATE_FILE"
-    fi
-
-    if command -v deb-systemd-helper >/dev/null 2>&1; then
-      deb-systemd-helper enable google-guest-agent-manager.service google-guest-compat-manager.service >/dev/null 2>&1
-      deb-systemd-helper disable google-guest-agent.service gce-workload-cert-refresh.timer >/dev/null 2>&1
-    fi
-
-    if command -v deb-systemd-invoke >/dev/null 2>&1; then
-      deb-systemd-invoke start google-guest-agent-manager.service google-guest-compat-manager.service >/dev/null 2>&1
-      deb-systemd-invoke stop google-guest-agent.service gce-workload-cert-refresh.timer >/dev/null 2>&1
-    else
-      systemctl --no-reload enable google-guest-agent-manager.service google-guest-compat-manager.service >/dev/null 2>&1
-      systemctl --no-reload disable google-guest-agent.service gce-workload-cert-refresh.timer >/dev/null 2>&1
-      systemctl start google-guest-agent-manager.service google-guest-compat-manager.service >/dev/null 2>&1
-      systemctl stop google-guest-agent.service gce-workload-cert-refresh.timer >/dev/null 2>&1
+    # Turn the old agent service and timer off (and don't fail on dpkg if this cannot run)
+    if [ -d /run/systemd/system ]; then
+      if command -v deb-systemd-helper >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+        deb-systemd-helper disable google-guest-agent.service gce-workload-cert-refresh.timer >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
+      fi
+      if command -v deb-systemd-invoke >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+        deb-systemd-invoke stop google-guest-agent.service gce-workload-cert-refresh.timer >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
+      else
+        systemctl --no-reload disable google-guest-agent.service gce-workload-cert-refresh.timer >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
+        systemctl stop google-guest-agent.service gce-workload-cert-refresh.timer >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
+      fi
     fi
     ;;
 esac
 
 #DEBHELPER#
 
-exit 0
+exit 0
\ No newline at end of file
diff --git a/debian/rules b/debian/rules
index 23d013d..c2fac2d 100755
--- a/debian/rules
+++ b/debian/rules
@@ -60,6 +60,11 @@ override_dh_auto_install:
 	ln -sf ../bin/ggactl_plugin debian/google-guest-agent/usr/sbin/ggactl_plugin_cleanup
 	install -p -m 0755 google_metadata_script_runner_adapt debian/google-guest-agent/usr/bin/
 
+	# Default conffile (to be preserved across updates)
+	install -d debian/google-guest-agent/etc/google-guest-agent
+	printf '%s\n' 'true' > debian/google-guest-agent/etc/google-guest-agent/core-plugin-enabled
+	chmod 0644 debian/google-guest-agent/etc/google-guest-agent/core-plugin-enabled
+
 override_dh_systemd_enable:
 	install -d debian/google-guest-agent/lib/systemd/system
 	install -p -m 0644 *.service debian/google-guest-agent/lib/systemd/system/
